meta: FBA shipment plans, restock alerts and stock checks so you avoid stockouts and storage fees. From $100, delivered in 7 days or less.
h1: Amazon inventory and FBA, planned and tracked
overview: We get on top of your Amazon stock. We review your FBA inventory, restock limits, aged and stranded items and stockout risks, then prepare shipment plans in Seller Central with correct units, prep and labels. We set restock alerts, work out how much to send and when, and give you a stock sheet to keep. You choose and pay the carrier, and we never touch your supplier payments.

faq: No. We prepare shipment plans, box content and label guidance in Seller Central. You or your supplier packs and sends the boxes, and you pay the carrier. We never handle your parcels.
Do you work with both FBM and FBA?
Both. Our main focus is FBA, but we also check FBM stock and the cut-off times for orders you ship yourself, so the same stock sheet works for both.
Will you choose how much to send?
We recommend quantities from your sales rate, lead time and storage cost, and show the working. You approve each shipment plan before it is created.
Stock that is in Amazon's warehouse but has no active listing, so it cannot sell. We find these, fix the listing issue or prepare removal, and tell you the costs of each choice.
